changes:
**New since 0.89.11**
- Cmd-click on macOS or Ctrl-click on Linux follows links to headings in the same document, so you can jump to a section without leaving Marktone.
- Links use the theme’s accent colour. Lists sit flush with the text column, and consistent line heights and balanced code-block padding make documents easier to scan.
- Help opens with the Marktone heading and introduction, without a separate About section.
- On macOS, installing Marktone keeps the terminal launcher in step with the installed app.
